model_id: airkingbd/dplm2_bit_650m (HF, pytorch_model.bin 2,616,587,562 bytes, last modified 2025-05-11; config dplm_type=dplm2_bit_esm, codebook_embed_dim=13) + structure tokenizer airkingbd/struct_tokenizer
what_this_is: 'DPLM-2 Bit': the only weights released for the DPLM-2.1 paper (arXiv 2504.11454). It implements the paper's bit-wise structure-token modelling only. The paper's other designs (flow-matching/hybrid structure sampling, geometric modules, representation alignment, multimer training) are NOT in these weights; the README says 'the full implementation will be released soon' and no further checkpoint exists on HF as of 2026-11-11. So this is a partial DPLM-2.1, equal to the 'DPLM-2 Bit' row of the README folding table.
code: bytedance/dplm @ 8a2e15e, patched only for python 3.11 dataclass defaults and the missing openfold CUDA extension

settings.input: sequence only; all structure tokens masked
settings.decode: from final_struct_feature (continuous quantised feature) as in generate_dplm2.save_results

hardware: NVIDIA H200; GPUs were shared with other jobs for part of the run, so seconds_per_protein is inflated and not a clean speed measurement
training_data_cutoff: no date cutoff stated in the README; per our reading of the DPLM-2 paper the training data are experimental PDB structures plus AFDB-SwissProt predicted structures (not re-verified here)

reproduction_gate.outcome: RMSD reproduced (within 0.02 A); TM not reproduced (0.07 lower), cause not found

sanity.scorer: python/eval/metrics.py all_metrics on CA, residues with finite ref coords
